title: Remember My Error: a project's agent mistakes (errors/agent-errors.json)
description: Every mistake an agent made on this project: a blocked task, a stage the Design Manager sent back, a rejected photo, a QA defect, or an approval the operator refused. Each names the rule that would have prevented it; the same rule is kept, once, in the harness's memory/errors/<agent>.md and read by that agent before its next task.

stage.description: The stage, task, gate or approval where it happened.
